arChildNodes.szComment:
ATHRPA responds the Player saying: "Are you certain to want to see your vision despite the warnings?" 

Then ATHRPA reaches out, hands trembling but sure, and lifts the Sightless Eye.
Her body convulses. The Sightless Eye burns in her grasp like a star. The Eye drops from her hands and rolls across the floor, dimming. ATHRPA crumples - still breathing.
